title: consolidate-lint-manifest-and-dep-approval-bot
author: Ethan Park
description: Motivation: Our lint/test config is scattered across multiple workflows and repo roots which causes inconsistent linting results and hard-to-debug failures. At the same time dependency upgrade PRs generated by the bot are noisy and often require human triage for innocuous version bumps. This PR does two related things in one deployable change: 1) create a single source-of-truth lint manifest (ci/lint/manifest.yaml) and rewire all GH Actions + internal CI runners to reference it; 2) add a small dependency-approval GitHub App shim (scripts/ci/dep-approver) that auto-labels and fast-tracks low-risk dependency bumps while queueing complex upgrades behind a manual review gate. Summary of work: - Consolidate ESLint, Prettier, and TypeScript lint entrypoints into a single manifest that defines per-package overrides, allowed rule exceptions, and path-based exemptions. - Replace duplicate workflow-level rule lists with a manifest reader action (ci/actions/read-lint-manifest). - Collapse three lint workflows into one staged-lint.yml with explicit fast-path lanes for docs/examples and a full-lint lane for core packages. - Implement dep-approver shim that evaluates depdiffs using lightweight heuristics (semver range, presence in protected-files list, changes in transitive deps) and applies labels: dep/auto, dep/manual, dep/risky. - Add a new merge gate step in staged-lint.yml that fails fast for lint regressions and posts inline annotations to the PR via the GH Checks API. Rollout plan: - Deploy manifest and action in feature branch (this PR). - Run staged-lint.yml in parallel on a small subset of active repos for 48h using a flag controlled in repo settings. - Inspect metrics (lint pass-rate, queue-times) and dep-approver labels for 7 days. - Flip default behavior for all repos and remove deprecated workflows. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate lint rules and publish manifest - [x] Implement read-lint-manifest action - [x] Replace existing lint workflows with staged-lint.yml - [x] Add dep-approver shim and unit tests - [x] Update README and CONTRIBUTING docs with new lint rules and how dep-approver labels map to automation - [x] Run canary on three active repos for 48h - [x] Add alerting for lint pipeline regressions (console/alerting/lintrunner) Related: ENG-9142 (lint consistency), ENG-9201 (reduce dep noise), SUP-3345 (customer incident referencing broken lint gating). Notes: The dep-approver deliberately errs conservative: any dep touching server/runtime/infra files is labeled dep/manual. The heuristics are intentionally simple to make future audit easier.

review_discussion:
Priya Shah: Please add unit tests around the manifest parser for path-based overrides.
Ethan Park: Added tests in scripts/ci/fixtures and updated heuristics.test.ts (see commit 71d0c6e).
Diego Martinez: The fast-path condition looks risky for mono-repo changes touching docs and packages. Can we gate by a repo-level flag first?
Ethan Park: We implemented the gate flag and the staged-lint workflow reads repository.settings.ci_fastpath (defaults to false) — docs updated.
Lena Karp: CI run failed initially due to an action permissions issue when posting annotations. Re-ran with GH_TOKEN scope fix.
Priya Shah: Approving with one nit: make the dep-approver logs more verbose when labeling dep/risky for triage.
Ethan Park: Added structured log lines and a follow-up ticket ENG-9358 to extend the runtime knowledge graph.
ci_summary: Checks: unit-tests (pass), integration-smoke (pass), staged-lint (pass after 1 rerun), e2e-nightly (skipped for this PR), dependency-scan (pass). One transient failure in staged-lint due to action permissions; rerun succeeded.
release_notes: Consolidated lint configuration into a single manifest and replaced multiple lint workflows with a staged pipeline. Added a dependency-approval shim that auto-labels low-risk upgrades and reduces noisy manual triage. No functional changes to runtime. Rollout controlled by repo-level flag.
post_merge_actions:
- Remove deprecated workflows in a follow-up cleanup PR
- Monitor metrics: lint pass-rate, PR queue time, dep-approver label distribution for 2 weeks
- Create ENG-9358 to expand dep heuristics and integrate with model-registry for runtime-sensitive dependencies
notes_for_oncall: If the staged-lint job starts to fail for many PRs, flip repo.settings.ci_fastpath=false and open an incident runbook; alerting is configured at console/alerting/lintrunner/alert-rule.yaml. The dep-approver can be disabled by revoking its app installation or setting scripts/ci/dep-approver/config.enabled=false in repo settings.
approvals: Approved by Priya Shah and Diego Martinez after CI green. Merge small conflict resolution with main (squash).
